_why: ADR 0176's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
The ADR shipped its table as prose -- seven mutations across three files,
each with the tests it claimed would catch it -- and no set file, which
check_mutation_tables_reproducible.py flags. This is that table as a
record the harness can re-run.
Every mutation is a restore of a defect the ADR names, at the line it
names. B1/B2 attack the FRONTIER -- the row dict Tests/fallback_logic.py
builds from a BRENDA entry -- by dropping or fabricating its buffer key.
B3/B4 attack the GATE in caterva/agents/assay_window.py in both
directions: never demand a buffer, and always demand one. B5/B6 attack
the scout's chosen row in caterva/agents/scouts.py: drop its buffer, or
forward-copy the replaced default's buffer into it (the provenance error
ADR 0172 forbids). B7 removes buffer_mismatch from the critic's
constraint route in caterva/agents/critics.py, back to notes-only.
The test command runs BOTH files the ADR cites in full, not the tests
that look most relevant: the real-chain sensor
test_a_real_buffer_survives_to_the_result_and_the_frontier lives in
Tests/test_fallback_logic.py and the window, scout and critic tests in
caterva/tests/test_agent_assay_window.py. ADR 0026's set narrowed to one
file once and reported a confident NOT CAUGHT that was a real catch in
the other file; the guard's note on this is right.
Run:  python3 scripts/mutate.py --set docs/mutations/adr-0176-the-frontier-carries-a-buffer-axis.json

mutations.description: the frontier row loses its buffer key
the frontier row carries a fabricated buffer (Tris) instead of the parsed one
the buffer gate is removed from within_window (buffer always satisfied)
mutations._claimed: caught by the silence, different-buffer, critic-window and scout tests

mutations.description: the gate is forced on always -- every row demanded a buffer even when the reference names none
mutations._claimed: caught by the no-buffer-required window test, the scout, and the pH whole-loop flagship

mutations.description: the chosen row's buffer is dropped (buffer=None)
mutations._claimed: caught by the scout's buffer selection test and the whole-loop buffer flagship

mutations.description: the replaced default's buffer is forward-copied into the new row
mutations._claimed: caught by the scout's buffer selection test and the whole-loop buffer flagship; the provenance error ADR 0172 forbids

mutations.description: buffer_mismatch removed from the critic's constraint route (back to notes-only)
mutations._claimed: caught by the two critic buffer tests and the whole-loop buffer flagship
